```text
# #2644: Patch: audit the codebase for dead code, duplicates and zombie routes, 2026-11-01
Opened by @github-actions[bot].

The code audit ([this run](https://github.com/Jlore-Studios/JackiOh/actions/runs/41259917329), every three days while none is open) asks for one pull request
that removes dead code and merges duplicated logic, and proves every change. It repeats #900's audit
(its findings and their proofs are on that issue), whose pull request was #953. A person reviews and
merges it (`person merges`), so make each change easy to check. Dead files and the agent instructions
have the weekly hygiene run's own issues: leave them to those.

## 1. Dead code

Find every function, type, constant, export and dependency that nothing references. The methods that
worked in #900:
- **Rust:** rename each low-hit `pub` item in a scratch copy, then run `cargo check --workspace
  --all-targets` with every feature on (`testkit`, `ts`, `luau/ts`, `wasm/preview`), and put back each
  rename the compiler names. Blank the `#[allow(dead_code)]`s and check again. An item only its own
  tests use is dead with them.
- **TypeScript:** grep each `export` of `apps/web/src` and `e2e` with
  `git grep -nw <name> -- apps e2e crates`. Rule out `import.meta.glob`, the barrels and test globs.
- **Python:** grep each `def` and module-level name of `analysis/`, `training/` and `scripts/`. Rule out
  `getattr` dispatch, `unittest` discovery and subprocess entry points.

Those that look dead but are not (#900):
- the 30 `#[no_mangle]` WASM exports, called from `apps/web/src/wasm/index.ts`;
- the server constants `tests/export_config.rs` writes into `serverConfig.ts`;
- the engine's "decide" switches, which `rulings_config.rs` and CLAUDE.md rule 9 pin;
- `PUBLIC_ENV_VARS`, read as text by `env-production.test.ts`;
- `cards → jackioh-luau`, which the generated registry calls;
- the generated wire types: the fix for an unused one is in Rust (its `ts(export)` or its
  `export_config.rs` row), never a TypeScript delete;
- test seams a test drives live machinery through, such as the `*ForTests` hooks.

## 2. Duplicates

Find logic written more than once: rules, cost, validation, dates, API calls, auth, RNG, and JSON or
storage helpers. Read each pair side by side, and merge one into a shared function only when the same
inputs give the same outputs, edge cases included; then update every caller. The per-card scripts are
parallel on purpose.

## 3. Zombie routes

List what calls each HTTP and WebSocket route (`crates/server/src/app.rs` `ROUTES`), each page
(`apps/web/src/main.tsx`), each WASM export and each WebSocket message, tests counted apart. Flag what
nothing calls; delete none of them (CLAUDE.md rule 13).

## Never

- Never delete anything called from outside this codebase (CLAUDE.md rule 13): a webhook, a workflow's
  `schedule:`, an auth callback, a route a deploy probes or a person calls (`/readyz` is Render's health
  check, and deploy-watch polls `/api/catalog`), or a `cargo jackioh`, server or harness subcommand a
  workflow, a deploy or a person runs. Name it in the pull request for a person instead.
- Never delete a test or a function a ruling's `proven_in` needs: `cargo jackioh spec check` passes.
- Never delete a named constant nothing reads before asking whether it should be read (CLAUDE.md rule 9).
- Never change `.github/`, `bot/`, `.harness/`, `.squishy/` or `.claude/`. Name what should go there in
  the pull request, for a person.

## Done when

The pull request body has a table of every removal and merge: what, where, and the evidence (the
commands you ran and what they printed), one commit per batch. The fast checks pass: `cargo fmt
--check`, `cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings`, the tests of every crate or package you
touched, `cargo jackioh spec check`, and the web's typecheck and eslint. Nothing to remove? Make no
change and say so in your answer, with your evidence.

---
_Opened by `.github/workflows/code-audit.yml`._
```

# Draft plan for #2644 (code audit 2026-11-01) — planner's working notes (run 2)

## State
- Run 1's /tmp/audit was gone (new machine); run 2 redid the setup.
- Last audits: #2350 (commit 81e2bbb88, 2026-10-29) and #2161 (df6b05c33). 225 commits since 81e2bbb88.
- No fragment needed: a dead-code removal plays no card differently (docs/issues-and-patches.md).
- Rust method: scratch copy /tmp/audit/ws (git archive HEAD), target /tmp/audit/target (copy of the
  shared target). /tmp/audit/scripts/pub_candidates.py lists `pub` items whose name is in no tracked
  file outside its crate's src/ (1482; 1476 non-mod made `pub(crate)` by apply.py), every
  `#[allow(dead_code)]` stripped (9 files), then
  `cargo check --workspace --all-targets --features jackioh-engine/testkit,jackioh-engine/ts,jackioh-luau/ts,jackioh-wasm/preview,jackioh-wasm/duos,jackioh-wasm-luau/preview --message-format short`
  -> /tmp/audit/check1.log (running).
- Subagents running: TS dead exports, Python dead code, zombie routes, duplicates (Rust+TS).
- `#[allow(dead_code)]` in src: crates/tools/src/patches.rs:72 (module-wide), crates/tools/src/fuzz.rs:355,
  crates/cards/build.rs:75; in tests: ai/tests/ai/support.rs:16, engine/tests/rules/{mod.rs:144,mod_2.rs:6,
  game_summary.rs:117,combat_property.rs:94}, server/tests/api/rate_limit.rs:56.

## Findings so far
- Rust iteration: privacy errors (E0364/E0365 re-exports, "type X is private" via inference) reverted by
  /tmp/audit/scripts/revert.py (31 so far, /tmp/audit/reverted.txt). check3 runs with JSON to attribute
  each warning to lib vs lib-test (/tmp/audit/check3.json).
- Engine lib: dead_code only on test-only items, all KEPT (ruling tests use them):
  wire/codes.rs find_code_in_text/excluded_characters/formatted_caret/is_code_separator (R191 proven_in
  codes.rs, twin of apps/web/src/wire/codes.ts); wire/emotes.rs is_voice_emote (r643 test),
  portrait_entry (r641 test); wire/stats.rs seats_counted (reference_card_stats in tests).
  Fields cry/resume of KyCompetitionScript/KyTestScript/NightMarketScript and ChaosEffectName::ALL are
  false positives (type made pub(crate) in scratch, read from cards).
- Re-export lists (subsystems/mod.rs config re-exports, prelude's FUSED_DIGEST_MARK etc., lib.rs
  `pub use card_on_card::*`, carriers, instance_view) re-export names nobody outside names: deliberate
  API (TS path parity), leave.
- #2350 (last audit) kept test-only ruling helpers and did mostly duplicate merges; no fragment.
- Warnings counted per location: 2x = dead in lib AND lib-test (truly dead); 1x = test-only use.
- CONFIRMED Rust removals so far:
  * crates/cards/src/versions.rs:91-94 `is_marked` (2x dead): #2546 (496b44030, 2026-10-30) moved
    its 3 callers (replay.rs, tools inspect, parse_game_record_in_file) to `scheme_of`.
  * crates/cards/src/versions.rs:86-89 `current_versions_in`: only caller left is its test
    (r1371000_a_name_the_retcon_kept_or_never_had_is_its_own, line ~190); identical to
    `versions_now_in(1, ·)` (version_alias_from(1,n) returns version_alias(n)). Test assertion
    switches to `versions_now_in(1, "selfplay-learned-v0.3.17-1.jsonl")`.
  * crates/engine/src/subsystems/call_to_chaos.rs:287-299 `ChaosEffectName::ALL` (2x dead, no
    `ChaosEffectName::ALL`/`Self::ALL` anywhere). KEEP `as_str` (tests/rules/call_to_chaos.rs uses
    CHAOS_RECURSION.as_str()).
  * CANDIDATE (contract change): crates/cards/src/query.rs:123-160 `CatalogSurface` + `catalog`
    const: no card script calls `catalog.query/pool/cost/trap_types` (git grep in crates: only
    tests/cross/query.rs:119-123 and docs). README §3 (crates/cards/README.md:226-236) and query.rs
    header :36-39 document it. Decide.
- False positives (types pub(crate)'d in scratch, used via inference): ThreadOverrides::install
  (server tests/support/test_app.rs:172), Ky*Script fields, as_str.
- tools/src/patches.rs test-only items under its documented module allow: leave.
